title: Monday's launch needs you; the team waits on your signatures
headline: The team kept working into the evening: a second review page (a founder), the phone bug fixed and checked, LAB 06 and 07, Appendix A ready to regenerate, and the historian's 31 timeline findings on RC1. But the book's next step is now yours alone: the RC1 revision waits on D6, and Monday's Leanpub launch needs four things only you can do. The storyteller has idled twice; Q6 asks whether the team should slow down while it waits.
